title: Azure / AKS / Cluster (platform metrics)
description: AKS cluster health from Azure Monitor platform metrics (microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters) for clusters without managed Prometheus, plus an Azure Resource Graph inventory. Managed by Terraform (azure-managed-grafana): edit dashboards/aks/aks-cluster-platform-metrics.json, not the dashboard in the UI. Changes made in Grafana are overwritten on the next apply.

links.title: Azure portal
links.tooltip: Open the selected resource in the Azure portal

links.title: Diagnose and solve problems
links.tooltip: Azure's built-in diagnostics for the selected resource

links.title: Operations overview
links.tooltip: State, alerts and changes across all covered resources

panels.title: Troubleshooting - $resource
panels.description: Start here when something looks wrong: is the resource running, has an alert fired, what changed? Resource Graph data; it lags a few minutes behind Azure. Grafana's identity needs read access (Monitoring Reader) on the resource.

panels.title: State
panels.description: Current state from Azure Resource Manager. Green: running/ready. Red: stopped, deallocated, failed or disabled. Orange: anything else, e.g. updating or starting.

azureResourceGraph.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters' and resourceGroup =~ '$rg' and name =~ '$resource'
| project ['Power state'] = tostring(properties.powerState.code), ['Provisioning'] = tostring(properties.provisioningState)

panels.title: Open alerts
panels.description: Azure Monitor alerts fired on this resource and not closed (alerts are kept 30 days). History across resources: the bundled Azure / Alert Consumption dashboard.

azureResourceGraph.query:
alertsmanagementresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/alerts'
| extend e = properties.essentials
| where tolower(tostring(e.targetResource)) == tolower('/subscriptions/$sub/resourceGroups/$rg/providers/Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/$resource')
| where tostring(e.monitorCondition) == 'Fired' and tostring(e.alertState) != 'Closed'
| summarize ['Open alerts'] = count()

panels.title: Changes (time range)
panels.description: Resource Manager changes to this resource and its child resources in the time range (Resource Graph change history, kept 14 days). Details on the right.

azureResourceGraph.query:
resourcechanges
| extend target = tolower(tostring(properties.targetResourceId))
| where (target == tolower('/subscriptions/$sub/resourceGroups/$rg/providers/Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/$resource') or target startswith strcat(tolower('/subscriptions/$sub/resourceGroups/$rg/providers/Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/$resource'), '/'))
| where todatetime(properties.changeAttributes.timestamp) between ($__timeFrom() .. $__timeTo())
| summarize Changes = count()

panels.title: What changed
panels.description: Latest Resource Manager changes in the time range: who changed what, with which operation, and which properties. A change just before a problem started is the first suspect.

azureResourceGraph.query:
resourcechanges
| extend target = tolower(tostring(properties.targetResourceId))
| where (target == tolower('/subscriptions/$sub/resourceGroups/$rg/providers/Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/$resource') or target startswith strcat(tolower('/subscriptions/$sub/resourceGroups/$rg/providers/Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/$resource'), '/'))
| where todatetime(properties.changeAttributes.timestamp) between ($__timeFrom() .. $__timeTo())
| project Time = todatetime(properties.changeAttributes.timestamp),
          Change = tostring(properties.changeType),
          Resource = iff(target == tolower('/subscriptions/$sub/resourceGroups/$rg/providers/Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/$resource'), '(this resource)', substring(target, strlen(tolower('/subscriptions/$sub/resourceGroups/$rg/providers/Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/$resource')) + 1)),
          ['Changed by'] = tostring(properties.changeAttributes.changedBy),
          Operation = tostring(properties.changeAttributes.operation),
          Properties = strcat_array(bag_keys(properties.changes), ', ')
| order by Time desc
| take 50

panels.title: Allocatable CPU cores
panels.description: Total number of available CPU cores in the cluster (kube_node_status_allocatable_cpu_cores).

panels.title: Allocatable memory
panels.description: Total amount of available memory in the cluster (kube_node_status_allocatable_memory_bytes).

panels.title: Node CPU (avg)
panels.description: node_cpu_usage_percentage, average across nodes.

panels.title: Node CPU (busiest node)
panels.description: node_cpu_usage_percentage, maximum across nodes.

panels.title: Node memory working set (avg)
panels.description: node_memory_working_set_percentage, average across nodes.

panels.title: Node memory working set (max)
panels.description: node_memory_working_set_percentage, maximum across nodes.

panels.title: Running pods
panels.description: kube_pod_status_phase, phase = Running. Count metric: Total aggregation at a fixed 1-minute grain (PT1M), so each point is the number of objects in that minute. Coarser grains would sum several minutes.

panels.title: Pending pods
panels.description: kube_pod_status_phase, phase = Pending. Count metric: Total aggregation at a fixed 1-minute grain (PT1M), so each point is the number of objects in that minute. Coarser grains would sum several minutes.

panels.title: Failed pods
panels.description: kube_pod_status_phase, phase = Failed. Count metric: Total aggregation at a fixed 1-minute grain (PT1M), so each point is the number of objects in that minute. Coarser grains would sum several minutes.

panels.title: Node disk used (max)
panels.description: node_disk_usage_percentage, maximum across nodes and devices.

panels.title: API server CPU (max)
panels.description: apiserver_cpu_usage_percentage: maximum CPU percentage (of the current limit) used by the API server pods.

panels.title: etcd database usage (max)
panels.description: etcd_database_usage_percentage. Microsoft recommends reviewing object counts when it stays above 50%.

panels.title: AKS clusters in subscription
panels.description: Azure Resource Graph: every AKS cluster in the selected subscription. nodes = sum of the agent pool `count` values.

azureResourceGraph.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters'
| mv-expand pool = properties.agentPoolProfiles
| summarize nodePools = count(), nodes = sum(toint(pool['count']))
    by name, resourceGroup, location,
       kubernetesVersion = tostring(properties.kubernetesVersion),
       currentKubernetesVersion = tostring(properties.currentKubernetesVersion),
       powerState = tostring(properties.powerState.code),
       provisioningState = tostring(properties.provisioningState),
       skuTier = tostring(sku.tier)
| order by name asc

panels.title: Node CPU usage %
panels.description: node_cpu_usage_percentage per node.

panels.title: Node memory working set %
panels.description: node_memory_working_set_percentage per node (can exceed 100% of allocatable).

panels.title: Node disk used % (busiest device)
panels.description: node_disk_usage_percentage per node, maximum across devices.

panels.title: Node conditions
panels.description: kube_node_status_condition: number of nodes per condition and status. Count metric: Total aggregation at a fixed 1-minute grain (PT1M), so each point is the number of objects in that minute. Coarser grains would sum several minutes.

panels.title: Node network in
panels.description: node_network_in_bytes (network received bytes) per node.

panels.title: Node network out
panels.description: node_network_out_bytes (network transmitted bytes) per node.

panels.title: Pods by phase
panels.description: kube_pod_status_phase split by phase. Count metric: Total aggregation at a fixed 1-minute grain (PT1M), so each point is the number of objects in that minute. Coarser grains would sum several minutes.

panels.title: Pods by ready condition
panels.description: kube_pod_status_ready split by condition. Count metric: Total aggregation at a fixed 1-minute grain (PT1M), so each point is the number of objects in that minute. Coarser grains would sum several minutes.

panels.title: Pending / Failed / Unknown pods by namespace
panels.description: kube_pod_status_phase filtered to unhealthy phases, split by namespace. Count metric: Total aggregation at a fixed 1-minute grain (PT1M), so each point is the number of objects in that minute. Coarser grains would sum several minutes.

panels.title: API server CPU / memory
panels.description: Maximum CPU / memory percentage (of the current limit) used by the API server pods.

panels.title: etcd CPU / memory / database
panels.description: Maximum etcd CPU / memory percentage (of the current limit) and database utilisation across instances.

panels.title: API server inflight requests (preview)
panels.description: apiserver_current_inflight_requests by request kind (preview metric).

panels.title: API request concurrency (preview)
panels.description: apiserver_flowcontrol_executing_seats: API Priority and Fairness seats in use, by priority level (preview metric).

panels.title: Pod scheduling rate (preview)
panels.description: scheduler_schedule_attempts_rate by result, e.g. scheduled / unschedulable (preview metric).

panels.title: Unschedulable pods / unneeded nodes
panels.description: Cluster autoscaler preview metrics (5-minute minimum grain). Empty when the autoscaler is not enabled.

panels.title: Autoscaler health / scale-down cooldown
panels.description: 1 = autoscaler considers the cluster healthy / scale-down is in cooldown. 5-minute minimum grain.
